title: A wide open set of An open basalt court around a sun-well of white-gold fire, iron floor veined with slag-gold, heat shimmer, storm sky above, no walls. Most of the ground is bare floor, with wide empty space between the features. The features are few, small beside the place, and spaced far apart. The floor reaches the edges of the model. Not a crowded diorama and not a boxed platform. No human figures, figurines, statues, animals, or readable text. Small features only: sun well, about 2.2 meters across: One low circular stone fire ring with a bowl of white-gold flame; anvil altar, about 1.8 meters across: One blacksmith anvil of dark forged iron; throne dais, about 5 meters across: One low rectangular stone dais with worn steps; gate column l, about 4.2 meters across: One twisted marble column; gate column r, about 4.2 meters across: One twisted marble column. The whole place is about 22 meters wide, 30 meters deep, and 18 meters tall.
author: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, TRELLIS.2
